theme.inspiration: MengTo/kage, Kyoto Temple Sanmon, Japanese Editorial Typography, GSAP Motion

headings.strategy: Wide display sans, tracking-tighter for impact, massive sizes for hero, Japanese vertical callouts.

body.strategy: Clean geometric body for high legibility against deep dark ink backgrounds.

mono.strategy: Technical indices, chapter numbers (00-07), and metadata pills.

japanese.strategy: Kanji chapter badges and vertical decorative margin text.

typography.pairing_archetype: Japanese Editorial Future (Unbounded + Outfit + JetBrains Mono + Noto Sans JP)

colors.archetype: Ink Black, Pale Bone, Vermilion Moon, and Burning Ember
rules: Use deep charcoal ink #05070A as the foundational backdrop.
Fixed Three.js WebGL canvas runs behind the DOM layer with continuous scroll-driven camera spline.
Accentuate with blood/vermilion red #E0231C for moon, torii details, active states, and focal points.
Keep glass panels translucent with blur to let the 3D lanterns, moon, and falling sakura petals shine through.

3d_and_motion.webgl_world: A fixed full-screen Three.js environment with procedural Torii gates, Sanmon pagoda pavilions, flickering stone lanterns, vermilion moon corona halo, drifting sakura/maple particles, and depth fog.
3d_and_motion.camera_spline: Smooth mathematical spline interpolation linking vertical scroll progress [0, 1] to 3D camera coordinates across Chapters 00 through 07.
3d_and_motion.chapter_rail: Interactive vertical right-hand rail indicating and allowing quick jump to active chapters.
3d_and_motion.mouse_parallax: Subtle exponential camera offset responding to cursor position for organic spatial depth.
